tenderSchedule.title: Maintenance of Park, Medians and Circles in Kengal Hanumanthaiah - 18 ward Parks
tenderSchedule.description: Estimate cost is for annual maintenance of parks, medians, circles, borewells, toilets, park equipments, watering of medians, emergency works and security to parks etc., pertaining zone-1 (Rajarajeshwarinagar) of Bengaluru West City Corporation under Greater Bengaluru Authority jurisdiction of Bengaluru.
tenderSchedule.locationName: BWCC Senior Assistant Director of Horticulture Zone 1

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of Senior Assistant Director of Horticulture, Zone-1, BWCC, RHCS layout, Annpurneshwarinagara, Nagarabhavi

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other Terms and Conditions as per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Work Done Certificate in same line of Service

Executed in any one year, the following minimum quantities of work. Horticulture Park Maintenance work at least one work in the last 5 years not less than 80% of the quantities or area of the estimated value of the contract.
Same service last year Performance Certificate.
Turnover Certificate from last five years 2021-2022, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Valid ESI, EPF and Labour Certificate

Latest 12 Months GST, ESI and EPF Paid Challans of October-2025 to September-2026 for above 20 lakh rupees of tender amount and Latest 6 Months GST, ESI and EPF Paid Challans of April-2026 to September-2026 for below 20 lakh rupees of tender amount
Contractor must pay at least 15 labour PF as per the minimum labour requirement for park maintenance. Contractor paying less number labour PF is liable for rejection.

Selection of the tender is based on the turnover and ECR and PF paid challans details as the one of the criteria for selection of successful Service provider. Hence have to submit all the documents compulsory.
Income Tax Returns and Balance Sheet March of 2021-2022, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 with TDS
GST Registration Certificate and PAN Card
The tenderer should submit value valid original Line of Credit of 30% of estimate value issued by Nationalized/Scheduled Bank for tender amount of Rs. 50.00 lakhs above only.
